classification.difficultyReason: Convert an annual rate to a monthly growth factor and model beginning-of-month deposits as a geometric series with an extra month of interest.

content.prompt: Mia deposits $\$250$ at the beginning of each month for 4 years into an account earning 7.2% p.a., compounded monthly. Find the value of her investment at the end of the 4 years. Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
Monthly growth factor:
$$r=1+\frac{0.072}{12}=1.006.$$
Number of deposits: $n=4\times12=48$.

Payments are made at the beginning of each month.

After 1 month: $250r$.

After 2 months: $250r^2+250r$.

After 48 months: $250r^{48}+250r^{47}+\cdots+250r$.

This is a geometric series with $a=250r$, $r=1.006$ and $n=48$.
$$FV=\frac{250r(r^{48}-1)}{r-1}.$$
Substituting $r=1.006$:
$$\begin{align*}FV&=\frac{250(1.006)(1.006^{48}-1)}{0.006}\\FV&\approx\$13\,941.90.\end{align*}$$
